title: Small profinite action-space site and parameter functors
statement: Use the compatible universes and small profinite parameter category $B=\operatorname{AsSmall}_{u+1}(\operatorname{Profinite}_u)$ with its canonical functor $\operatorname{par}:B\to\operatorname{Profinite}_u$ from [def-sfb-profinite-action-base-coefficients]. Let $J$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group in universe $u$. Write $A_J$ for the category of profinite spaces with continuous left $J$-action and continuous equivariant maps, as in [def-sfb-profinite-action-parameters]. Define $\operatorname{Space}_J=\operatorname{AsSmall}_{u+1}(A_J)$. Define $U_J:\operatorname{Space}_J\to\operatorname{Profinite}_u$ by the canonical functor to $A_J$ followed by forgetting the action. Define a precoverage $\mathcal C_J$ by declaring a presieve $W$ on $T$ covering precisely when its set of arrows is finite and for every $x\in U_J(T)$ there exist an arrow $f:V\to T$ in $W$ and $y\in U_J(V)$ with $U_J(f)(y)=x$. Thus the empty presieve covers exactly the empty underlying space. Transport the trivial and free parameter functors $t_J,H_J$ of [def-sfb-profinite-action-parameters] to $B\to\operatorname{Space}_J$ by precomposing with $\operatorname{par}$ and postcomposing with the canonical inclusion into the small model. Explicitly, $t_J(S)$ retains $\operatorname{par}(S)$ with trivial action, while $H_J(S)=J\times\operatorname{par}(S)$ with $a\cdot(j,s)=(aj,s)$, and the induced maps are respectively $f$ and $(j,s)\mapsto(j,f(s))$. These are the actual spaces and maps, transported only by the canonical small-model equivalences; no coherent-presentation theorem or equivalence is part of these definitions.
